midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary canvas, hero backgrounds, deep surface — the foundational dark that absorbs the electric blue glow and makes it feel like signal emerging from noise

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Violet outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

arc-cyan.$description: Arc Cyan — Atmospheric accent and glow halos around the particle sphere, rare decorative energy that reads as electricity rather than UI

halo-violet.$description: Halo Violet — Soft gradient midtone that bridges Signal Blue into Midnight Ink, used in the radial background wash and ambient surface tinting

carbon.$description: Carbon — Dark mode text on light surfaces, button text fallback — an almost-black that stays warmer than pure #000

slate-body.$description: Slate Body — Body text on light product sections, secondary metadata, paragraph copy

fog.$description: Fog — Muted text, helper copy, de-emphasized labels, ghost-bordered links on light backgrounds

mist.$description: Mist — Tertiary text and disabled labels — one step quieter than Fog

silver-border.$description: Silver Border — Hairline dividers on light product surfaces, card outlines, table separators

paper.$description: Paper — Product surface fills, dashboard canvas, light section backgrounds, button text on dark

open-suace-sans-regular.$description: Open Suace Sans Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

f37-bolton.$description: Small-caps labels and eyebrow text, slightly tracked for a technical/industrial feel that contrasts with the body sans

open-sauce-sans.$description: Body copy, subheadings, nav links, card content — the workhorse sans, comfortable line-height (1.5+) at 16-18px keeps long product copy readable without losing the editorial pacing set by Bolton

ibm-plex-mono.$description: Micro-labels, data tags, order IDs, status badges — the monospaced faces with wide tracking are reserved for data/system chrome, creating a visual distinction between human-readable copy and machine-generated metadata

open-suace-sans-light.$description: Open Suace Sans Light — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

f37-bolton-book.$description: F37 Bolton Book — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

f37-bolton-medium.$description: F37 Bolton Medium — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
